title: Entity patches: what PatchBus carries
description: Field-level writes to the document (contracts/collab.md). A patch names one entity by its map and id, and one leaf inside it. Patches are stateless JSON, so the same batch runs through clan-store's LocalPatchBus today and the sync service later. A batch is atomic: every patch applies or none does, and it is one decision in the chain and one undo step.

entity.description: A map of document.schema.json (project: the root object, its id is project.id). upstream is never patched.

path.description: A leaf inside the entity, '/' between parts: duration_s, camera/size, timeline/item_X, timeline/item_X/source/in_s. Never v, field_v or id. The leaf rules are in collab.md.

value.description: create: the whole entity (its id, v and field_v are filled by the bus). set: the leaf's new value; null removes an optional leaf.

base_version.description: The entity's v the writer saw (0 for a create). A set conflicts when its leaf's field_v is newer.

Why.description: The decision the batch records. action starts with a collab.md verb (plan, render, pick, restore, …). agent is the claim: human:<personId> for a person, the crewId for an agent. A job's landing cites <doc-id>#jobs[<jobId>] and carries reasoning.

reasoning.description: clan-sdk Reasoning: decided, evidence, alternatives, certainty.

quiet.description: Bookkeeping (a job's state, a checkpoint): the data changes and no decision is written.

PatchResult.description: What happened to a batch. applied false: nothing changed, and conflicts or refused say why.

v.description: The new version of every entity the batch touched, by '<entity>/<id>'.

inverse.description: The batch that undoes this one (an undo step stores it).
